active_kb_record.text:
冷却水温度与压力参数
Heat extraction HT system and preheater sizes Start-up of an engine at arctic conditions (air intake temperatures of the en- gine below +0°C) has to be done with a preheated engine (normal start), see section Start-up and load application, Page 68. Engine operation under arctic conditions and at low load carries the risk of heat loss in the cooling water systems and resulting risk of engine operation problems or even damage. Therefore 3 cases are given: Case 1 Preheating of the intake air of the engine to a minimum of 0°C Case 2 Installation of adequate HT preheater, that operates in parallel to engine oper- ation to compensate HT energy losses If operation within Range I is required, a) the preheater size within the plant must be capable to compensate any heat losses within the cooling water system and to keep these on the required temperature level.

中央冷却系统有多种变化形式，可根据船东或建造商的具体要求进行讨论。适用条件：每套装置。

active_kb_record.text:
冷却水温度与压力参数
Engine operation under arctic conditions and at low load carries the risk of heat loss in the cooling water systems and resulting risk of engine operation problems or even damage. Therefore 3 cases are given: Case1 Preheating of the intake air of the engine to a minimum of 0°C. Case 2 Installation of adequate HT preheater, that operates in parallel to engine oper- ation to compensate HT energy losses. If operation within Range I is required, a) the preheater size within the plant must be capable to compensate any heat losses within the cooling water system and to keep these on the required temperature level. b) all preheaters need to be operated in parallel to engine operation until min- imum engine load is reached.

active_kb_record.text:
冷却水温度与压力参数
SEBD0518-09 Proper cooling system design and maintenance is an important part of the satisfactory operation and service life of an engine. Understanding how the cooling system works can help reduce owning and operating costs. Function The temperature of burning fuel in Caterpillar Engines can reach 1927° C (3,500° F). However, only about 33% of this total heat is converted into crankshaft horsepower. Approximately 30% is expelled through exhaust, while another 7% is radiated directly into the atmosphere from engine surfaces. The remaining 30% must be dissipated through a carefully designed cooling system. The cooling system must remove heat in order to keep the engine at the correct operating temperature. Heat extraction HT system and preheater sizes Start-up of an engine at arctic conditions (air intake temperatures of the en- gine below +0°C) has to be done with a preheated engine (normal start), see section Start-up and load application, Page 68. Engine operation under arctic conditions and at low load carries the risk of heat loss in the cooling water systems and resulting risk of engine operation problems or even damage. Therefore 3 cases are given: Case 1 Preheating of the intake air of the engine to a minimum of 0°C Case 2 Installation of adequate HT preheater, that operates in parallel to engine oper- ation to compensate HT energy losses If operation within Range I is required, a) the preheater size within the plant must be capable to compensate any heat losses within the cooling water system and to keep these on the required temperature level.

Engine operation under arctic conditions and at low load carries the risk of heat loss in the cooling water systems and resulting risk of engine operation problems or even damage. Therefore 3 cases are given: Case1 Preheating of the intake air of the engine to a minimum of 0°C. Case 2 Installation of adequate HT preheater, that operates in parallel to engine oper- ation to compensate HT energy losses. If operation within Range I is required, a) the preheater size within the plant must be capable to compensate any heat losses within the cooling water system and to keep these on the required temperature level. b) all preheaters need to be operated in parallel to engine operation until min- imum engine load is reached.

SEBD0518-09 Proper cooling system design and maintenance is an important part of the satisfactory operation and service life of an engine. Understanding how the cooling system works can help reduce owning and operating costs. Function The temperature of burning fuel in Caterpillar Engines can reach 1927° C (3,500° F). However, only about 33% of this total heat is converted into crankshaft horsepower. Approximately 30% is expelled through exhaust, while another 7% is radiated directly into the atmosphere from engine surfaces. The remaining 30% must be dissipated through a carefully designed cooling system. The cooling system must remove heat in order to keep the engine at the correct operating temperature. 危险环境冷却水布置要求：冷却水系统应布置成在船舶于危险大气中运行时，无需直接取用海水即可冷却机械及相关装置，例如通过箱式冷却或壳体冷却。适用条件：船舶在危险大气中运行期间。

可支撑：冷却水系统布置应考虑来源文件提出的安装操作或维护可达性原则。具体施工空间、支架、接口和验收要求仍应由项目安装规范确认。
不能支撑：1. 不能直接给出焊接空间、操作空间、支架间距、冲洗接口或试压接口的具体要求。2. 不能替代船厂施工规范、管系布置标准或安装验收程序。3. 不能直接支撑冷却水温度、压力和流量参数限值。

  内容: 冷却液冰点与乙二醇比例：冷却液浓缩液储存能力规格适用于原装、密封包装，储存温度最高为30°C；冷却液浓缩液限值品牌名称/备注防冻剂约3年，需遵守制造商规范。适用条件：储存于原装密封包装，温度≤30°C。

  [量化参数] 30°C、约3年

  内容: 冷却液水质检测方法：当使用化学添加剂时，测试设备应依据供应商建议；供应商提供的测试套件可用于测定淡水水质。

适用对象/类别（冷却液，无添加剂）：总硬度 ≤ 10 dGH；pH值 6.5 – 8 在20 °C；氯离子含量 ≤ 50 mg/l。适用条件：用于填充和补充的水（无添加剂）。

适用对象/类别（冷却液，有添加剂）：总硬度 ≤ 10 dGH；pH值 ≥ 7.5 在20 °C；氯离子含量 ≤ 50 mg/l。适用条件：循环水（有添加剂）。

冷却液水质检测方法：当使用化学添加剂时，测试设备应依据供应商建议；供应商提供的测试套件可用于测定淡水水质。

适用对象/类别（冷却液，无添加剂）：总硬度 ≤ 10 dGH；pH值 6.5 – 8 在20 °C；氯离子含量 ≤ 50 mg/l。适用条件：用于填充和补充的水（无添加剂）。

适用对象/类别（冷却液，有添加剂）：总硬度 ≤ 10 dGH；pH值 ≥ 7.5 在20 °C；氯离子含量 ≤ 50 mg/l。适用条件：循环水（有添加剂）。

可支撑：coolant 的 inspection；water_quality；environmental_protection 参数应依据来源文件厂家技术数据或项目计算文件确定。若原文给出明确限值，可作为对应适用对象和工况下的参数约束。

不能支撑：2. 不能超出来源文件限定的厂家、机型、系统型式或工况范围泛化。3. 不能直接支撑施工安装、冲洗试压或图纸送审完整性要求。

active_kb_record.text:
冷却液冰点与乙二醇比例：服务时间 = 12000小时或6年；Cat ELC不需要频繁添加SCA（补充冷却液添加剂）；在6000服务小时或ELC使用寿命的一半时，仅需添加Extender；Cat ELC以1:1预混合冷却液形式提供，使用蒸馏水；预混合ELC提供防冻保护至-37°C（-34°F）；预混合ELC推荐用于冷却系统的初始加注；预混合ELC也推荐用于冷却系统的加满；ELC浓缩液也可使用；ELC浓缩液可将冰点降低至-52°C（-62°F），适用于北极条件。适用条件：Cat ELC冷却液，基于Caterpillar EC-1规范。

ascertained and evaluated on an ongoing basis. Any time a substantial amount of cooling water is changed or added, the inhibitor concentration should be checked to ensure a proper level. Improved O-ring compound (peroxide cured) In cases of repeated cooling water leakages from the cool - ing jackets on the cylinder liner or the cylinder cover, we recommend installation of our new O-rings of an improved compound. The new O-rings will provide improved resis - tance against high temperatures and steam in areas where deposits and foreign particles are restricting water flow. The peroxide cured O-rings are not standard on all engine types, but will be delivered on request from our PrimeServ organisation. In our previous SL2001-393, we recommended the use of oversize O-rings (i.e. O-rings with a slightly larger cross section).

active_kb_record.text:
冷却液污染与沉积风险
Corrosion is a chemical or electrochemical action that gradually wears away metal surfaces in the cooling system. In some instances, corrosion can eventually destroy an engine. All cooling system components need protection from corrosion. Supplemental coolant additives are used to protect metal surfaces. They coat these surfaces and prevent the formation of scale, rust, and cavitation erosion. Types of cooling system corrosion are pitting and cavitation erosion, rust, acidity-alkalinity imbalance caused erosion, and galvanic and electrolytic corrosion. Other functional effects of coolants with no, or low, levels of supplemental coolant additives are aeration and the formation of scale and deposits. Pitting and Cavitation-Erosion Electrical current flow in a localized area is one of the causes of pitting corrosion. Pitting is the most damaging type of corrosion.

水质参数要求
In closed circuits only Additives may only be used in closed circuits where no significant consump- tion occurs, apart from leaks or evaporation losses. Observe the applicable environmental protection regulations when disposing of coolant containing additives. For more information, consult the additive supplier. Chemical additives Sodium nitrite and sodium borate based additives etc. have a proven track re- cord. Galvanised iron pipes or zinc sacrificial anodes must not be used in cooling systems. This corrosion protection is not required due to the pre- scribed coolant treatment and electrochemical potential reversal that may oc- cur due to the coolant temperatures which are usual in engines nowadays. If necessary, the pipes must be deplated. Slushing oil For MAN Energy Solutions engines, it is not permissible to use corrosion pro- tection oils in the cooling water circuit.

active_kb_record.text:
冷却液水质检测方法：当使用化学添加剂时，测试设备应依据供应商建议；供应商提供的测试套件可用于测定淡水水质。

适用对象/类别（冷却液，无添加剂）：总硬度 ≤ 10 dGH；pH值 6.5 – 8 在20 °C；氯离子含量 ≤ 50 mg/l。适用条件：用于填充和补充的水（无添加剂）。

适用对象/类别（冷却液，有添加剂）：总硬度 ≤ 10 dGH；pH值 ≥ 7.5 在20 °C；氯离子含量 ≤ 50 mg/l。适用条件：循环水（有添加剂）。

冷却液水质检测方法：总硬度 ≤ 10 dGH；适用条件：水类型为处理过的冷却液（循环水，含添加剂）。
冷却液水质检测方法：pH值 6.5 – 8 在 20 °C；适用条件：水类型为清水（无添加剂），用于填充和再填充。
冷却液水质检测方法：pH值 ≥ 7.5 在 20 °C；适用条件：水类型为处理过的冷却液（循环水，含添加剂）。
冷却液水质检测方法：氯离子含量 ≤ 50 mg/l；适用条件：水类型为清水（无添加剂），用于填充和再填充。
冷却液水质检测方法：氯离子含量 ≤ 50 mg/l；适用条件：水类型为处理过的冷却液（循环水，含添加剂）。

active_kb_record.text:
冷却液冰点与乙二醇比例：服务时间 = 12000小时或6年；Cat ELC不需要频繁添加SCA（补充冷却液添加剂）；在6000服务小时或ELC使用寿命的一半时，仅需添加Extender；Cat ELC以1:1预混合冷却液形式提供，使用蒸馏水；预混合ELC提供防冻保护至-37°C（-34°F）；预混合ELC推荐用于冷却系统的初始加注；预混合ELC也推荐用于冷却系统的加满；ELC浓缩液也可使用；ELC浓缩液可将冰点降低至-52°C（-62°F），适用于北极条件。适用条件：Cat ELC冷却液，基于Caterpillar EC-1规范。

可支撑：coolant 的 water_quality；maintenance；temperature 参数应依据来源文件厂家技术数据或项目计算文件确定。若原文给出明确限值，可作为对应适用对象和工况下的参数约束。
不能支撑：2. 不能超出来源文件限定的厂家、机型、系统型式或工况范围泛化。3. 不能直接支撑施工安装、冲洗试压或图纸送审完整性要求。

冷却液水质检测方法：未处理冷却液的性质必须符合以下限值：总硬度 ≤ 10 dGH；pH值 6.5 – 8；氯离子含量 ≤ 50 mg/l。适用条件：水质类型为蒸馏水或淡水，无外来杂质。1 dGH（德国硬度）≙ 10 mg CaO/升水 ≙ 17.9 mg CaCO3/l ≙ 0.357 mval/l ≙ 0.179 mmol/l；1 mg/l ≙ 1 ppm。MAN Energy Solutions 水质检测设备包含直接测定上述水性质的装置。防腐蚀剂制造商也提供用户友好的检测设备。冷却水检查说明见 010.005 Engine – Work Instructions 010.000.002-03。若使用蒸馏水（例如来自淡水发生器）或完全脱盐水，需注意相关要求。

可支撑：coolant 的 inspection；water_quality 参数应依据来源文件、厂家技术数据或项目计算文件确定。若原文给出明确限值，可作为对应适用对象和工况下的参数约束。
不能支撑：2. 不能超出来源文件限定的厂家、机型、系统型式或工况范围泛化。3. 不能直接支撑施工安装、冲洗试压或图纸送审完整性要求。

active_kb_record.text:
冷却液污染与沉积风险
Corrosion is a chemical or electrochemical action that gradually wears away metal surfaces in the cooling system. In some instances, corrosion can eventually destroy an engine. All cooling system components need protection from corrosion. Supplemental coolant additives are used to protect metal surfaces. They coat these surfaces and prevent the formation of scale, rust, and cavitation erosion. Types of cooling system corrosion are pitting and cavitation erosion, rust, acidity-alkalinity imbalance caused erosion, and galvanic and electrolytic corrosion. Other functional effects of coolants with no, or low, levels of supplemental coolant additives are aeration and the formation of scale and deposits. Pitting and Cavitation-Erosion Electrical current flow in a localized area is one of the causes of pitting corrosion. Pitting is the most damaging type of corrosion.

active_kb_record.text:
水质参数要求
In closed circuits only Additives may only be used in closed circuits where no significant consump- tion occurs, apart from leaks or evaporation losses. Observe the applicable environmental protection regulations when disposing of coolant containing additives. For more information, consult the additive supplier. Chemical additives Sodium nitrite and sodium borate based additives etc. have a proven track re- cord. Galvanised iron pipes or zinc sacrificial anodes must not be used in cooling systems. This corrosion protection is not required due to the pre- scribed coolant treatment and electrochemical potential reversal that may oc- cur due to the coolant temperatures which are usual in engines nowadays. If necessary, the pipes must be deplated. Slushing oil For MAN Energy Solutions engines, it is not permissible to use corrosion pro- tection oils in the cooling water circuit.

active_kb_record.text:
温度控制阀配置
Separate Circuit Aftercooled with Heat Exchangers with Aftercooler Seawater Recirculation The separate circuit aftercooler cooling system must be designed with sufficient capacity for the hottest water and the higher ambient air conditions for operation in climates where both air and seawater temperatures run to extremes. This results in a cooler with excess capacity in cold seawater and warm air conditions. This can result in condensation in the engine’s intake system, especially during prolonged light engine load. Extremely cold seawater in the aftercooler can also cause condensation when engine inlet air temperatures are relatively warm with high moisture content. The thermostatic valve used should not allow the temperature of the water to the aftercooler to exceed 30°C (85°F).

active_kb_record.text:
冷却水温度与压力参数
Preheating Engines starting on HFO and engines in stand-by position must be preheated. It is also recommended to preheat engines operating on MDO due to the pro- longed life time of the engines' wearing parts. Therefore it is recommended that the preheating is arranged for automatic operation, so that the preheating is disconnected when the engine is running, and connected when the engine is in stand-by position. The preheating is adjusted so that the temperature is ≥ 60°C at the top cover (see thermometer TI12), and approximately 25 to 45°C at out- let of the cylinders (see thermometer TI10). When working out the external cooling water system it must be ensured, that no cold cooling water is pressed through the engine and thus spoiling the pre- heating during stand-by.

active_kb_record.text:
温度控制阀配置
standstill of the engine. For max. permissible temperatures, see section Start- ing conditions, Page 66. For details contact Everllence. The system components of the LT cooling water circuit are designed for a max. LT cooling water temperature of 38°C, with a corresponding seawater temperature of 32°C (tropical conditions). However, the capacity of the cooler for LT cooling water (HE-024) is determ- ined by the temperature difference between seawater and LT cooling water. Due to this correlation, an LT freshwater temperature of 32°C can be ensured at a seawater temperature of 25°C. To meet the IMO Tier I/IMO Tier II regulations the set point of the LT cooling water temperature control valve (MOV-016) is to be adjusted to 32°C. How- ever this temperature will fluctuate and reach at most 38°C with a seawater temperature of 32°C (tropical conditions).

Separate Circuit Aftercooled with Heat Exchangers with Aftercooler Seawater Recirculation The separate circuit aftercooler cooling system must be designed with sufficient capacity for the hottest water and the higher ambient air conditions for operation in climates where both air and seawater temperatures run to extremes. This results in a cooler with excess capacity in cold seawater and warm air conditions. This can result in condensation in the engine’s intake system, especially during prolonged light engine load. Extremely cold seawater in the aftercooler can also cause condensation when engine inlet air temperatures are relatively warm with high moisture content. The thermostatic valve used should not allow the temperature of the water to the aftercooler to exceed 30°C (85°F).

active_kb_record.text:
冷却水温度与压力参数
Preheating Engines starting on HFO and engines in stand-by position must be preheated. It is also recommended to preheat engines operating on MDO due to the pro- longed life time of the engines' wearing parts. Therefore it is recommended that the preheating is arranged for automatic operation, so that the preheating is disconnected when the engine is running, and connected when the engine is in stand-by position. The preheating is adjusted so that the temperature is ≥ 60°C at the top cover (see thermometer TI12), and approximately 25 to 45°C at out- let of the cylinders (see thermometer TI10). When working out the external cooling water system it must be ensured, that no cold cooling water is pressed through the engine and thus spoiling the pre- heating during stand-by.

11.1.2 The main engines cooling water systems shall fulfil the following requirements:.1 Sea-water cooling system of one main engine shall be provided with two pumps, one of which shall be a stand-by pump. The capacity of the stand-by pump shall not be less than that of the main pump. At least one of the pumps shall have independent drive. It is admissible to apply one common, independently driven stand -by pump for both sea and fresh water. The capacity of the pump shall not be less than that of the main pumps. Provision shall be made, however, to prevent the mixing of seawater and fresh water..2 Sea and fresh water cooling systems of two or more engines, may be served by: – separate pumps for each engine and in such a case no stand-by pumps are required, or – one pump for sea -water system of capacity sufficient for simultaneous cooling of all

不能支撑：2. 不能超出来源文件限定的厂家、机型、系统型式或工况范围泛化。3. 不能直接支撑施工安装、冲洗试压或图纸送审完整性要求。

淡水侧系统组成：No. of cylinders, config. 6L/7L/8L/9L/10L；LT cooling water air cooler inlet = 38 °C (setpoint 32 °C)；Lube oil engine inlet = 65 °C；Nozzle cooling water engine inlet = 60 °C。适用条件：淡水侧系统组成。
Charge air cooler outlet HP：Air flow rate = 45,376 /h（6L）、52,939 /h（7L）、61,054 /h（8L）、68,054 /h（9L）、76,316 /h（10L）；Mass flow = 49.7 t/h（6L）、57.9 t/h（7L）、66.8 t/h（8L）、74.5 t/h（9L）、83.5 t/h（10L）；Charge air pressure (absolute) = 6.90 bar abs（6L）、6.90 bar abs（7L）、6.75 bar abs（8L）、6.90 bar abs（9L）、6.75 bar abs（10L）；Air required to dissipate heat radiation (engine) = 39,969 /h（6L）、46,630 /h（7L）、53,291 /h（8L）、59,953 /h（9L）、66,614 /h（10L）。适用条件：Charge air cooler outlet HP。
Exhaust gas data：Volume flow (temperature turbocharger outlet) = 90,189 /h（6L）、105,223 /h（7L）、120,407 /h（8L）、135,284 /h（9L）、150,511 /h（10L）；Mass flow = 51.2 t/h（6L）、59.7 t/h（7L）、68.9 t/h（8L）、76.8 t/h（9L）、86.1 t/h（10L）；Exhaust gas temperature at LP turbine outlet = 340 °C（6L）、340 °C（7L）、336 °C（8L）、340 °C（9L）、336 °C（10L）；Heat content (190 °C) = 2,306 kW（6L）、2,690 kW（7L）、3,002 kW（8L）、3,458 kW（9L）、3,753 kW（10L）；Permissible exhaust gas back pressure after turbocharger ≤ 50 mbar。适用条件：Exhaust gas data。
可支撑：main_engine_cooling_water_system 的 composition、pressure、flow 参数应依据来源文件厂家技术数据或项目计算文件确定。若原文给出明确限值，可作为对应适用对象和工况下的参数约束。
不能支撑：2. 不能超出来源文件限定的厂家、机型、系统型式或工况范围泛化。3. 不能直接支撑施工安装、冲洗试压或图纸送审完整性要求。

active_kb_record.text:
IACS UR M35 Rev.8 — Mandatory Alarms and Safeguards for Main IC Engines in Unattended Machinery Spaces (UMS):
- High cooling water temperature: mandatory alarm AND automatic slowdown or shutdown trigger
- Low cooling water pressure (HT and LT circuits): mandatory alarm
- Deaerating/expansion tank low level: mandatory alarm
- All parameters that could cause engine damage if unattended must have alarm + automatic protective response
Note: Numerical setpoints for alarms and slowdown/shutdown are engine manufacturer-specific and must be approved by the class society. The UR mandates the alarm exists; the threshold values are defined in the engine manufacturer's project guide and control system.

active_kb_record.text:
温度控制阀配置
• Incorporate deaeration circuit and air vents to eliminate air traps and locks. • A load balancing thermostatic valve must be used to direct coolant through a secondary cooling source to limit jacket water inlet temperature. • Coolant must continually flow through the exhaust heat recovery device when the engine is operating to avoid thermal shock on hot muffler surfaces. This may be accomplished using a low water flow shutdown device. • After engine shutdown, the coolant must continue to flow through the engine until the coolant temperature falls below 94°C (194°F) to avoid steam pockets forming inside the engine. • If the engine thermostats are removed, an external warm-up thermostat is required. • To keep external head within allowable limits for the engine- mounted pump, locate heat recovery mufflers and heat exchangers as near the engine as possible.

raw_row.topic: 系统运行可靠性
raw_row.shall_statement: 主机冷却水系统应配置不少于两台冷却水泵，其中至少一台为独立电力驱动，每台泵应具有在主机额定功率工况下单独满足冷却水流量需求的能力；系统应设置冷却水高温报警和自动保护功能，当冷却水温度超过报警设定值时发出报警，并在温度持续升高时触发自动保护动作。
raw_row.engineering_rationale: 本条覆盖方面【系统运行可靠性】，来自原始需求「具备较高运行可靠性，不能因冷却能力不足、冷却水循环中断或温度失控影响推进装置安全运行」。E-CCS-COOL-001 支撑了冷却水泵冗余配置和高温报警保护要求；E-PUMP-RED-002 支撑了至少两种冷却水供应方式且每种容量满足额定功率连续运行的要求；E-PUMP-RED-004 支撑了备用泵容量不小于主泵且至少一台独立驱动的要求；E-IACS-M35-001 支撑了高温冷却水报警和自动保护要求。依据 CCS 钢质海船入级规范第4篇第3章、ABS Marine Vessel Rules Part 4 7.7.1(a)、PRS Ship Machinery Piping Systems 11.1.2、IACS UR M35 Rev.8。
acceptance_criteria: 检查图纸确认冷却水泵台数不少于两台，且至少一台为独立电力驱动，每台泵容量满足主机额定功率工况下的冷却水流量需求。
检查报警和保护系统设计，确认设置冷却水高温报警和自动保护功能，报警设定值和保护动作阈值按主机厂家 Technical Data 确认。
调试期间模拟单泵故障，确认备用泵自动启动并维持主机运行，具体切换时间和维持功率按项目调试大纲确认。
raw_row.risk_if_unmet: 冷却能力不足或循环中断将导致主机过热停机，影响推进装置安全运行。

raw_row.engineering_rationale: 本条覆盖方面【热带海区高温环境适应性】，来自原始需求「热带海区高温环境」。E-DNV-COOL-001 支撑了冷却水进机温度保持在厂家限值内的要求；E-CCS-COOL-001 支撑了按最高海水温度设计的要求。依据 DNV Rules for Classification Ships Pt4 Ch3 Machinery 和 CCS 钢质海船入级规范第4篇第3章。
acceptance_criteria: 检查设计文件，确认设计海水温度和空气温度按项目设计基准（Design Basis）确认。
检查冷却水系统温度控制设计，确认冷却水进机温度限值按主机厂家 Technical Data 确认。
applicability_constraints: 本条需求基于 DNV 和 CCS 规则证据，适用范围限于相应规则，其他船级社规则应按各自要求另行确认。
raw_row.risk_if_unmet: 设计基准选择不当可能导致高温环境下冷却能力不足。

fields.exact_text: 冷却水系统设计应基于项目设计基准（Design Basis）中规定的最高海水温度和空气温度，确保冷却水进机温度不超过主机制造商规定的限值。

检查冷却水系统温度控制设计，确认冷却水进机温度限值按主机厂家 Technical Data 确认。

raw_row.topic: 负荷变化工况温度控制
raw_row.shall_statement: 主机冷却水温度控制系统应能在主机全负荷范围内自动调节冷却水温度，保持冷却水进机温度在厂家规定的限值内；系统应设置手动备用控制方式，并在温度超过高报警设定值时发出报警。
raw_row.engineering_rationale: 本条覆盖方面【负荷变化工况温度控制】，来自原始需求「主机负荷变化时保持稳定冷却能力」。E-CTRL-COOL-001 支撑了全负荷范围自动调节、手动备用和高温报警的要求；E-DNV-COOL-001 支撑了冷却水进机温度保持在厂家限值内的要求；E-TCV-SHUT-001 支撑了温度控制阀的配置要求。依据 IACS UR E10、DNV Rules for Classification Ships Pt4 Ch3 Machinery 和 Caterpillar 安装指南。
acceptance_criteria: 检查温度控制系统设计，确认具备全负荷范围自动调节功能，并设置手动备用控制方式。
检查报警功能设计，确认高温报警设定值按主机厂家 Technical Data 确认。
调试期间进行负荷变化试验，确认温度控制稳定，具体试验工况按项目调试大纲确认。
raw_row.risk_if_unmet: 负荷变化时温度控制不稳定将导致主机热应力增大或停机。

raw_row.topic: 负荷变化工况温度控制
raw_row.shall_statement: 温度控制阀应选用负载平衡恒温阀，能够根据冷却水温度自动调节通过二次冷却源的冷却液流量，以限制缸套水进水温度。
raw_row.engineering_rationale: 本条覆盖方面【负荷变化工况温度控制】，来自原始需求「主机负荷变化时保持稳定冷却能力」。E-TCV-SHUT-001 支撑了使用负载平衡恒温阀的要求；E-CTRL-COOL-001 支撑了自动调节的要求。依据 Caterpillar 冷却系统应用和安装指南和 IACS UR E10。
acceptance_criteria: 检查温度控制阀选型，确认选用负载平衡恒温阀，具体型号和参数按主机厂家 Technical Data 确认。
检查温度控制阀的安装和管路连接，确认符合厂家安装指南要求。
applicability_constraints: 本条需求基于 Caterpillar 安装指南证据，适用范围限于 Caterpillar 机型，其他厂家和机型应按各自 Technical Data 另行确认。
raw_row.risk_if_unmet: 温度控制阀选型不当将导致温度控制精度不足，影响主机运行稳定性。

exact_passages.text:
中国船级社（CCS）钢质海船入级规范 第4篇 第3章 — 冷却水系统
主推进机械的冷却水系统应设有不少于2台冷却水泵，其中至少1台应为独立电力驱动。各泵应具有在主机额定功率工况下单独满足冷却水流量需求的能力。系统应设置冷却水高温报警，报警值应不超过主机制造商规定的最高允许温度。当冷却水温度超过允许值时，应能自动减速或停机保护。
冷却水系统的设计应能在主机最大连续功率（MCR）条件下，在航行海区最高海水温度（不低于32°C）时保持正常工作，热带航区应不低于35°C。
整理说明：CCS规则对主机冷却水系统泵配置、报警和系统设计提供了中国船级社规范级依据，可支撑国内船厂建造项目的合规性要求。

exact_passages.text:
DNV Rules for Classification: Ships, Pt.4 Ch.3 — Cooling Water Systems
The cooling water system for main propulsion engines shall be designed so that the cooling water temperatures at the engine inlet are maintained within the limits specified by the engine manufacturer. For high-temperature (HT) fresh water circuits, the maximum inlet temperature to the engine shall not exceed 36°C above the thermostat opening temperature under worst-case ambient conditions.

(2020) There are to be at least two means to supply cooling water or other medium to the engines, and air compressors, coolers, reduction gears, etc, associated with the operation of these engines. 11.1.2 The main engines cooling water systems shall fulfil the following requirements:.1 Sea-water cooling system of one main engine shall be provided with two pumps, one of which shall be a stand-by pump. The capacity of the stand-by pump shall not be less than that of the main pump. At least one of the pumps shall have independent drive. It is admissible to apply one common, independently driven stand -by pump for both sea and fresh water.

冷却水泵冗余配置
11.1.2 The main engines cooling water systems shall fulfil the following requirements:.1 Sea-water cooling system of one main engine shall be provided with two pumps, one of which shall be a stand-by pump. The capacity of the stand-by pump shall not be less than that of the main pump. At least one of the pumps shall have independent drive. It is admissible to apply one common, independently driven stand -by pump for both sea and fresh water.

11.1.2 The main engines cooling water systems shall fulfil the following requirements:.1 Sea-water cooling system of one main engine shall be provided with two pumps, one of which shall be a stand-by pump. The capacity of the stand-by pump shall not be less than that of the main pump. At least one of the pumps shall have independent drive. It is admissible to apply one common, independently driven stand -by pump for both sea and fresh water. The capacity of the pump shall not be less than that of the main pumps. Provision shall be made, however, to prevent the mixing of seawater and fresh water..2 Sea and fresh water cooling systems of two or more engines, may be served by: – separate pumps for each engine and in such a case no stand-by pumps are required, or – one pump for sea -water system of capacity sufficient for simultaneous cooling of all

exact_passages.text:
主机冷却型式与设计条件：参考条件为热带条件；空气温度 45 °C；冷却水温度（低温级中冷器前）38 °C；总大气压力 1000 mbar；相对湿度 60%。适用条件：L/V49/60 IMO Tier II – 电力推进/EPROX-AC，1300 kW/cyl.，600 rpm – 电力推进/EPROX-AC，参考条件：热带。

主机冷却型式与设计条件：发动机负荷 100% 时，参考条件为热带，IMO 2008 和 IMO 2028。适用条件：L/V49/60 IMO Tier II – 电力推进/EPROX-AC，1300 kW/cyl.，600 rpm – 电力推进/EPROX-AC，参考条件：热带。

主机冷却型式与设计条件：发动机负荷 85% 时，参考条件为热带，IMO 2008 和 IMO 2028。适用条件：L/V49/60 IMO Tier II – 电力推进/EPROX-AC，1300 kW/cyl.，600 rpm – 电力推进/EPROX-AC，参考条件：热带。

主机冷却型式与设计条件：发动机负荷 100% 时，参考条件为热带，IMO 2008 和 IMO 2028。适用条件：L/V49/60 IMO Tier II – 电力推进/EPROX-AC，1300 kW/cyl.，600 rpm – 电力推进/EPROX-AC，参考条件：热带。

主机冷却型式与设计条件：发动机负荷 85% 时，参考条件为热带，IMO 2008 和 IMO 2028。适用条件：L/V49/60 IMO Tier II – 电力推进/EPROX-AC，1300 kW/cyl.，600 rpm – 电力推进/EPROX-AC，参考条件：热带。

主机冷却型式与设计条件：环境条件无需降额，前提是不超过以下参考条件（热带条件）；若超过以下数值，需进行特殊计算：涡轮增压器前空气温度 Tx ≤ 318 K（45 °C）/ 333 K（60 °C）；环境压力 ≥ 100 kPa（1 bar）/ 90 kPa；冷却水温度（低温级中冷器进口）≤ 311 K（38 °C）/ 316 K（43 °C）；压缩机前进气压力 ≥ -20 mbar / -40 mbar（1）；涡轮增压器后排气背压 ≤ 30 mbar / 60 mbar（1）。（1）表压。适用条件：Table 3: Available outputs / related reference conditions；POperating: Available output under local conditions and dependent on application；Dependent on local conditions or special application demands, a further load reduction of PApplication, ISO might be needed；De-rating 1: No de-rating due to ambient conditions is needed as long as following conditions are not exceeded；No de-rating up to stated reference conditions (Tropic)；Special calculation needed if following values are exceeded。

可支撑：cooler 的 load_reduction pressure temperature 参数应依据来源文件厂家技术数据或项目计算文件确定。若原文给出明确限值，可作为对应适用对象和工况下的参数约束。
不能支撑：2. 不能超出来源文件限定的厂家、机型、系统型式或工况范围泛化。3. 不能直接支撑施工安装、冲洗试压或图纸送审完整性要求。

exact_passages.text:
主机冷却型式与设计条件：Derating 定义，P Operating – Liquid fuel mode 相关降额因子；可用功率（输出）取决于当地条件和应用。取决于当地条件或特殊应用要求，可能需要进一步降低 P Application, ISO。  
1. No derating：无需降额，前提是满足所列条件；在规定的参考条件（热带）下无需降额，见下文：  
空气温度（涡轮增压器前）T ≤ 318 K (45 °C)；环境压力 ≥ 100 kPa (1 bar)；冷却水温度（中冷器 LT 级进口）≤ 311 K (38 °C)；压气机前进气压力 ≥ –2 kPa；涡轮增压器后排气背压 ≤ 5 kPa；相对湿度 Φ ≤ 60 %；低于/高于大气压力。适用条件：Table 15: Derating – Limits of ambient conditions。  
2. Derating：联系 MAN Energy Solutions。

active_kb_record.text:
主机冷却型式与设计条件：冷却水温度进气口充气冷却器（LT级）≤ 311 K（38°C）；适用条件：无降额，满足所列条件，环境温度在涡轮增压器前T ≤ 318 K（45°C），环境压力≥ 100 kPa（1 bar），进气压力在压缩机前≥ –2 kPa，排气背压在涡轮增压器后≤ 5 kPa，相对湿度Φ ≤ 60%。

可支撑：cooler 的 load_reduction pressure temperature 参数应依据来源文件厂家技术数据或项目计算文件确定。若原文给出明确限值，可作为对应适用对象和工况下的参数约束。
不能支撑：2. 不能超出来源文件限定的厂家、机型、系统型式或工况范围泛化。3. 不能直接支撑施工安装、冲洗试压或图纸送审完整性要求。

Exhaust gas data：Volume flow (temperature turbocharger outlet) = 90,189 /h（6L）、105,223 /h（7L）、120,407 /h（8L）、135,284 /h（9L）、150,511 /h（10L）；Mass flow = 51.2 t/h（6L）、59.7 t/h（7L）、68.9 t/h（8L）、76.8 t/h（9L）、86.1 t/h（10L）；Exhaust gas temperature at LP turbine outlet = 340 °C（6L）、340 °C（7L）、336 °C（8L）、340 °C（9L）、336 °C（10L）；Heat content (190 °C) = 2,306 kW（6L）、2,690 kW（7L）、3,002 kW（8L）、3,458 kW（9L）、3,753 kW（10L）；Permissible exhaust gas back pressure after turbocharger ≤ 50 mbar。适用条件：Exhaust gas data。

exact_passages.text:
IACS Unified Requirements E10 — Machinery Control Systems
Cooling water temperature control systems for main propulsion engines shall:
1. Maintain cooling water temperature within manufacturer's limits across the full engine load range through automatic modulation of the temperature control valve.
2. Be capable of manual override in case of automatic control failure.
3. Provide alarm when cooling water temperature exceeds the high alarm set-point.
4.

active_kb_record.text:
IACS UR M35 Rev.8 — Mandatory Alarms and Safeguards for Main IC Engines in Unattended Machinery Spaces (UMS):
- High cooling water temperature: mandatory alarm AND automatic slowdown or shutdown trigger
- Low cooling water pressure (HT and LT circuits): mandatory alarm
- Deaerating/expansion tank low level: mandatory alarm
- All parameters that could cause engine damage if unattended must have alarm + automatic protective response
Note: Numerical setpoints for alarms and slowdown/shutdown are engine manufacturer-specific and must be approved by the class society. The UR mandates the alarm exists; the threshold values are defined in the engine manufacturer's project guide and control system.

温度控制阀配置
• Incorporate deaeration circuit and air vents to eliminate air traps and locks. • A load balancing thermostatic valve must be used to direct coolant through a secondary cooling source to limit jacket water inlet temperature. • Coolant must continually flow through the exhaust heat recovery device when the engine is operating to avoid thermal shock on hot muffler surfaces. This may be accomplished using a low water flow shutdown device.

exact_passages.text:
温度控制阀配置
• Incorporate deaeration circuit and air vents to eliminate air traps and locks. • A load balancing thermostatic valve must be used to direct coolant through a secondary cooling source to limit jacket water inlet temperature. • Coolant must continually flow through the exhaust heat recovery device when the engine is operating to avoid thermal shock on hot muffler surfaces. This may be accomplished using a low water flow shutdown device.

active_kb_record.text:
温度控制阀配置
• Incorporate deaeration circuit and air vents to eliminate air traps and locks. • A load balancing thermostatic valve must be used to direct coolant through a secondary cooling source to limit jacket water inlet temperature. • Coolant must continually flow through the exhaust heat recovery device when the engine is operating to avoid thermal shock on hot muffler surfaces. This may be accomplished using a low water flow shutdown device. • After engine shutdown, the coolant must continue to flow through the engine until the coolant temperature falls below 94°C (194°F) to avoid steam pockets forming inside the engine. • If the engine thermostats are removed, an external warm-up thermostat is required. • To keep external head within allowable limits for the engine- mounted pump, locate heat recovery mufflers and heat exchangers as near the engine as possible.

预热循环泵控制要求
Circulating pump for preheater (4P04) If the main cooling water pump (HT) is engine driven, the preheater pump shall start when the engine stops (to ensure water circulation through the hot engine) and stop when the engine starts. active_kb_record.text:
预热循环泵控制要求
Circulating pump for preheater (4P04) If the main cooling water pump (HT) is engine driven, the preheater pump shall start when the engine stops (to ensure water circulation through the hot engine) and stop when the engine starts. The engine control system handles start/stop of the pump automatically via a motor starter.

raw_row.topic: 系统运行可靠性
raw_row.shall_statement: 主机冷却水系统应配置不少于两台冷却水泵，其中至少一台为独立电力驱动，各泵应具有在主机额定功率工况下单独满足冷却水流量需求的能力；系统应设置冷却水高温报警，当冷却水温度超过允许值时，应能自动减速或停机保护。
raw_row.engineering_rationale: 本条覆盖方面【系统运行可靠性】，来自原始需求「具备较高运行可靠性，不能因冷却能力不足、冷却水循环中断或温度失控影响推进装置安全运行」。E-CCS-COOL-001 支撑了泵冗余配置、独立驱动、单泵容量满足MCR以及高温报警和自动保护的要求；E-PUMP-RED-002 支撑了至少两种供水方式且每种容量满足额定功率连续运行的要求；E-PUMP-RED-004 支撑了备用泵容量不小于主泵且至少一台独立驱动的要求；E-IACS-M35-001 支撑了高温冷却水报警和自动减速或停机保护的要求。依据 CCS规范第4篇第3章、ABS 7.7.1(a)、PRS 11.1.2、IACS UR M35 Rev.8。
acceptance_criteria: 检查图纸确认冷却水泵台数不少于两台，且至少一台为独立电力驱动，各泵容量满足主机额定功率工况下单独运行要求。
检查报警和保护系统设计，确认设置冷却水高温报警，且当温度超过允许值时能自动触发减速或停机保护。
按主机厂家 Technical Data 确认高温报警设定值和自动保护动作阈值。
applicability_constraints: 本条基于 CCS、ABS、PRS 船级社规则和 IACS UR M35，适用于入级船舶主机冷却水系统；具体泵容量和报警阈值应按实际选定主机厂家 Technical Data 确认。
raw_row.risk_if_unmet: 冷却能力不足或循环中断将导致主机过热保护动作，影响推进装置安全运行。

raw_row.topic: 系统运行可靠性
raw_row.shall_statement: 冷却水系统应设计为在主机最大连续功率（MCR）条件下，在航行海区最高海水温度时保持正常工作，热带航区应按不低于项目设计基准的热带海水温度进行设计。
raw_row.engineering_rationale: 本条覆盖方面【系统运行可靠性】，来自原始需求「具备较高运行可靠性，不能因冷却能力不足、冷却水循环中断或温度失控影响推进装置安全运行」。E-CCS-COOL-001 支撑了系统在MCR和最高海水温度下保持正常工作的设计义务，并给出热带航区不低于35°C的规范要求；E-DNV-COOL-001 支撑了冷却水进机温度应保持在厂家限值内的要求。依据 CCS规范第4篇第3章和 DNV Pt.4 Ch.3。
acceptance_criteria: 检查热平衡计算书，确认系统在主机MCR工况和设计海水温度下冷却能力满足要求。
设计海水温度按项目设计基准（Design Basis）确认，并应不低于船级社规范要求的热带航区最低海水温度。
applicability_constraints: 本条基于 CCS 和 DNV 船级社规则，适用于入级船舶；具体设计海水温度应按项目设计基准和船级社规范共同确认。
raw_row.risk_if_unmet: 设计海水温度取值不足将导致热带航区冷却能力不够，触发主机降功率或停机。

fields.exact_text: 冷却水系统应设计为在主机最大连续功率（MCR）条件下，在航行海区最高海水温度时保持正常工作，热带航区应按不低于项目设计基准的热带海水温度进行设计。
检查热平衡计算书，确认系统在主机MCR工况和设计海水温度下冷却能力满足要求。
设计海水温度按项目设计基准（Design Basis）确认，并应不低于船级社规范要求的热带航区最低海水温度。

raw_row.topic: 热带海区高温环境适应性
raw_row.shall_statement: 主机冷却水系统应能在热带海区高温环境条件下保持稳定冷却能力，冷却水温度控制应满足主机厂家规定的进机温度限值，系统设计应覆盖热带环境参考条件。
raw_row.engineering_rationale: 本条覆盖方面【热带海区高温环境适应性】，来自原始需求「热带海区高温环境」。E-COOLER-PRESS-010 支撑了热带条件参考（冷却水温度38°C、空气温度45°C）下的设计条件；E-COOLER-LOAD-005 支撑了热带条件下无需降额的环境限值（冷却水温度≤38°C、空气温度≤45°C）；E-COOLER-LOAD-001 支撑了LT级冷却水进口温度≤38°C的无降额条件；E-SYS-COMP-021 支撑了LT冷却水进口温度设定值32°C和热带条件38°C的系统组成参数。上述证据均为厂家特定数据，需按实际选定主机厂家确认。
acceptance_criteria: 检查冷却系统热平衡计算书，确认在项目设计基准规定的热带海水温度和空气温度条件下，冷却水进机温度满足主机厂家限值。
按主机厂家 Technical Data 确认热带环境设计条件（海水温度、空气温度）及对应的冷却水温度限值。
调试期间按项目调试大纲验证热带工况模拟条件下冷却水温度稳定性。
applicability_constraints: 本条基于 MAN 49/60DF、49/60 及 L21/31 项目指南证据，适用范围限于对应厂家和机型；其他厂家和机型应按各自 Technical Data 另行确认。不同厂家和机型的温度限值不同，不得直接套用。
raw_row.risk_if_unmet: 热带海区高温环境下冷却能力不足将导致主机降功率或停机，影响船舶运营。

fields.exact_text: 主机冷却水系统应能在热带海区高温环境条件下保持稳定冷却能力，冷却水温度控制应满足主机厂家规定的进机温度限值，系统设计应覆盖热带环境参考条件。
检查冷却系统热平衡计算书，确认在项目设计基准规定的热带海水温度和空气温度条件下，冷却水进机温度满足主机厂家限值。
按主机厂家 Technical Data 确认热带环境设计条件（海水温度、空气温度）及对应的冷却水温度限值。
调试期间按项目调试大纲验证热带工况模拟条件下冷却水温度稳定性。

raw_row.topic: 负荷变化工况温度控制
raw_row.shall_statement: 主机冷却水温度控制系统应能在主机全负荷范围内自动调节温度控制阀，保持冷却水温度在主机厂家规定的限值内；应设置手动越控功能，并在自动控制失效时可用；当冷却水温度超过高报警设定值时，系统应发出报警。
raw_row.engineering_rationale: 本条覆盖方面【负荷变化工况温度控制】，来自原始需求「主机负荷变化时保持稳定冷却能力」。E-CTRL-COOL-001 支撑了全负荷范围自动调节、手动越控和高温报警的要求；E-DNV-COOL-001 支撑了进机温度保持在厂家限值内的设计义务；E-TCV-SHUT-001 支撑了负载平衡恒温阀限制缸套水进水温度的要求；E-IACS-M35-001 支撑了高温报警和自动保护的要求。依据 IACS UR E10、DNV Pt.4 Ch.3、IACS UR M35 Rev.8。
acceptance_criteria: 检查温度控制系统设计，确认温度控制阀具备全负荷范围自动调节功能，并设置手动越控装置。
检查报警系统设计，确认设置冷却水高温报警，报警设定值按主机厂家 Technical Data 确认。
调试期间按项目调试大纲验证负荷变化工况下温度控制阀自动调节性能和温度稳定性。
applicability_constraints: 本条基于 IACS UR E10、DNV 规则和 IACS UR M35，适用于入级船舶主机冷却水温度控制系统；E-TCV-SHUT-001 来自 Caterpillar 安装指南，其负载平衡恒温阀要求仅适用于对应厂家系统，其他厂家应按各自 Technical Data 确认。
raw_row.risk_if_unmet: 负荷变化时温度控制失效将导致冷却水温度超限，触发主机降功率或停机保护。

检查温度控制系统设计，确认温度控制阀具备全负荷范围自动调节功能，并设置手动越控装置。
检查报警系统设计，确认设置冷却水高温报警，报警设定值按主机厂家 Technical Data 确认。
调试期间按项目调试大纲验证负荷变化工况下温度控制阀自动调节性能和温度稳定性。

raw_row.topic: 负荷变化工况温度控制
raw_row.shall_statement: 高温淡水回路冷却水进机温度不应超过调温阀开启温度与船级社规范允许偏差之和，具体限值应按主机厂家 Technical Data 确认。
raw_row.engineering_rationale: 本条覆盖方面【负荷变化工况温度控制】，来自原始需求「主机负荷变化时保持稳定冷却能力」。E-DNV-COOL-001 支撑了HT回路进机温度不超过调温阀开启温度+36°C的规范限值；E-CTRL-COOL-001 支撑了温度控制阀自动调节以保持温度在厂家限值内的要求。依据 DNV Pt.4 Ch.3 和 IACS UR E10。
acceptance_criteria: 检查温度控制系统设计参数，确认高温淡水回路进机温度限值符合船级社规范要求。
按主机厂家 Technical Data 确认调温阀开启温度和进机温度允许偏差。
applicability_constraints: 本条基于 DNV 规则和 IACS UR E10，适用于入级船舶；具体温度限值应按实际选定主机厂家 Technical Data 确认，不同厂家和机型限值不同。
raw_row.risk_if_unmet: 进机温度超限将导致主机热负荷过高，影响安全运行。

active_kb_record.text:
淡水侧系统组成：LT冷却水压力（额定转速下增压空气冷却器进口）≤ 2 bar；PT4145压力传感器测量范围 2 bar 至 8 bar。适用条件：额定转速。

增压空气冷却器（LT级，额定流量）压力损失：6L机型 0.7 bar；7L机型 0.9 bar；8L机型 1.0 bar；9L机型 1.2 bar；10L机型 1.4 bar；12V机型 2.0 bar；14V机型 2.6 bar。适用条件：额定流量。

附设LT冷却水泵（额定转速下）压力升高：6L机型 3.6 bar；7L机型 3.5 bar；8L机型 3.3 bar；9L机型 3.9 bar；10L机型 3.8 bar；12V机型 4.3 bar；14V机型 4.9 bar。适用条件：额定转速。

调节温度：根据功率定义。在较高温度/较低压力下需要降低功率。

可支撑：main_engine_cooling_water_system 的 composition control pressure 参数应依据来源文件厂家技术数据或项目计算文件确定。若原文给出明确限值，可作为对应适用对象和工况下的参数约束。
不能支撑：2. 不能超出来源文件限定的厂家、机型、系统型式或工况范围泛化。3. 不能直接支撑施工安装、冲洗试压或图纸送审完整性要求。

active_kb_record.text:
L16/24S;L16/24：HT冷却水发动机出口温度设定点 79°C 标称（机械恒温元件范围 77-85°C）；LT冷却水发动机出口温度设定点 35°C 标称（机械恒温元件范围 29-41°C）；润滑油进口温度设定点 66°C 标称（机械恒温元件范围 63-72°C）。适用条件：参考工况为热带空气温度，发动机进水温度来自系统，空气压力、相对湿度按温度基准；HT冷却水先流经HT级增压空气冷却器，再流经水套和气缸盖，发动机出口水温由机械恒温器调节；LT冷却水先流经LT级增压空气冷却器，再流经滑油冷却器，发动机出口水温由机械恒温器调节。

可支撑：lt_cooling_water_loop 的 composition control pressure 参数应依据来源文件厂家技术数据或项目计算文件确定。若原文给出明确限值，可作为对应适用对象和工况下的参数约束。

active_kb_record.text:
主机冷却型式与设计条件：空气温度在涡轮增压器前 Tx ≤ 318 K (45 °C) / 333 K (60 °C)；环境压力 ≥ 100 kPa (1 bar) / 90 kPa；冷却水温度在进气冷却器进口（低温级）≤ 311 K (38 °C) / 316 K (43 °C)；压缩机前进气压力 ≥ -20 mbar / -40 mbar；涡轮增压器后排气背压 ≤ 30 mbar / 60 mbar。适用条件：Tier II，No de-rating up to stated reference conditions (Tropic)，Special calculation needed if following values are exceeded。

可支撑：cooler 的 pressure temperature calculation 参数应依据来源文件厂家技术数据或项目计算文件确定。若原文给出明确限值，可作为对应适用对象和工况下的参数约束。
不能支撑：2. 不能超出来源文件限定的厂家、机型、系统型式或工况范围泛化。3. 不能直接支撑施工安装、冲洗试压或图纸送审完整性要求。

raw_row.topic: 主机冷却水进出口参数
raw_row.shall_statement: 主机冷却水系统应设计为在发动机进口处的冷却水温度保持在主机制造商规定的限值内，高温淡水回路最高进口温度与恒温器开启温度之差不应超过36°C；冷却水温度应连续监控，高温报警设定值不得超过主机制造商允许的最高冷却水温度。
raw_row.engineering_rationale: 本条覆盖方面【主机冷却水进出口参数】，来自原始需求「主机入口和出口冷却水温度、压力、流量应满足主机厂家技术文件要求」。E-DNV-COOL-001 支撑了进机温度限值和高温回路温差限值（≤36°C）；E-IACS-M3-002 支撑了温度连续监控和报警设定值要求。依据 DNV Rules for Classification Ships Pt4 Ch3 Machinery 和 IACS UR M3.1。
acceptance_criteria: 设计审查确认冷却水系统设计满足进机温度限值要求，高温回路温差不超过36°C。
设计审查确认温度监控和报警设定值符合厂家最高允许温度。
raw_row.risk_if_unmet: 冷却水温度超限可能导致主机过热、部件损坏或停机。

raw_row.topic: 主机冷却水进出口参数
raw_row.shall_statement: 主机冷却水进口和出口的压力、流量参数应满足主机制造商技术文件规定的限值，具体数值按主机厂家 Technical Data 确认。
raw_row.engineering_rationale: 本条覆盖方面【主机冷却水进出口参数】，来自原始需求「主机入口和出口冷却水温度、压力、流量应满足主机厂家技术文件要求」。E-SYS-COMP-004 提供了低温冷却水压力限值（≤2 bar）的示例，但该证据为厂家特定（MAN），且未覆盖所有机型，因此压力、流量具体限值需按主机厂家 Technical Data 确认。
acceptance_criteria: 设计审查确认冷却水压力、流量参数符合主机厂家 Technical Data 要求，具体限值按主机厂家 Technical Data 确认。
applicability_constraints: 本条需求基于 MAN 证据，适用范围限于 MAN 特定机型，其他厂家和机型应按各自 Technical Data 另行确认。
raw_row.risk_if_unmet: 压力或流量不满足要求可能导致冷却不足或系统损坏。

fields.exact_text: 主机冷却水进口和出口的压力、流量参数应满足主机制造商技术文件规定的限值，具体数值按主机厂家 Technical Data 确认。
设计审查确认冷却水压力、流量参数符合主机厂家 Technical Data 要求，具体限值按主机厂家 Technical Data 确认。

raw_row.topic: 主机冷却水进出口参数
raw_row.shall_statement: 冷却水温度控制系统应能在全负荷范围内自动调节冷却水温度，维持温度在厂家限值内，并应设置手动备用控制方式；当冷却水温度超过高报警设定值时，系统应发出报警。
raw_row.engineering_rationale: 本条覆盖方面【主机冷却水进出口参数】，来自原始需求「主机入口和出口冷却水温度、压力、流量应满足主机厂家技术文件要求」。E-CTRL-COOL-001 支撑了温度控制系统全负荷自动调节、手动备用和高温报警功能要求。依据 IACS UR E10。
acceptance_criteria: 设计审查确认温度控制系统具备全负荷自动调节和手动备用功能。
设计审查确认高温报警设定值符合厂家要求。
raw_row.risk_if_unmet: 温度控制失效可能导致冷却水温度波动或超限。

fields.exact_text: 冷却水温度控制系统应能在全负荷范围内自动调节冷却水温度，维持温度在厂家限值内，并应设置手动备用控制方式；当冷却水温度超过高报警设定值时，系统应发出报警。
设计审查确认温度控制系统具备全负荷自动调节和手动备用功能。
设计审查确认高温报警设定值符合厂家要求。

raw_row.topic: 高低温回路设计参数一致性
raw_row.shall_statement: 高温冷却水回路和低温冷却水回路的设计参数应与主机技术数据、泵曲线、冷却器选型和热平衡计算结果保持一致，确保系统在设计工况下满足冷却需求。
raw_row.engineering_rationale: 本条覆盖方面【高低温回路设计参数一致性】，来自原始需求「高温冷却水回路和低温冷却水回路的设计参数应与主机技术数据、泵曲线、冷却器选型和热平衡计算保持一致」。E-HT-COMP-082 支撑了高温回路配置和温度参数；E-LT-COMP-005 和 E-LT-COMP-006 支撑了低温回路温度设定点；E-COOLER-PRESS-060 间接支撑了冷却器选型参数。
acceptance_criteria: 设计审查确认高低温回路设计参数与主机技术数据、泵曲线、冷却器选型和热平衡计算文件一致。
计算书审查确认热平衡计算覆盖设计工况。
applicability_constraints: 本条需求基于 MAN 特定机型证据，适用范围限于 MAN 机型，其他厂家和机型应按各自 Technical Data 另行确认。
raw_row.risk_if_unmet: 设计参数不一致可能导致冷却能力不足或设备选型不当。

raw_row.topic: 高低温回路设计参数一致性
raw_row.shall_statement: 高温冷却水回路和低温冷却水回路的设计参数应通过热平衡计算验证，计算工况和参数限值按主机厂家 Technical Data 确认。
raw_row.engineering_rationale: 本条覆盖方面【高低温回路设计参数一致性】，来自原始需求「高温冷却水回路和低温冷却水回路的设计参数应与主机技术数据、泵曲线、冷却器选型和热平衡计算保持一致」。E-DNV-COOL-001 要求中央冷却系统按最高海水温度设计，但具体设计海水温度需按项目设计基准确认。
acceptance_criteria: 设计审查确认热平衡计算覆盖设计工况，设计海水温度按项目设计基准（Design Basis）确认。
raw_row.risk_if_unmet: 热平衡计算不准确可能导致冷却系统容量不足。

fields.exact_text: 高温冷却水回路和低温冷却水回路的设计参数应通过热平衡计算验证，计算工况和参数限值按主机厂家 Technical Data 确认。

exact_passages.judge_reason: DNV规则明确要求主机冷却水进机温度保持在厂家限值内，HT回路进机温度不超过调温阀开启温度+36°C，直接支撑本需求中温度参数限值的要求。
exact_passages.text:
DNV Rules for Classification: Ships, Pt.4 Ch.3 — Cooling Water Systems
The cooling water system for main propulsion engines shall be designed so that the cooling water temperatures at the engine inlet are maintained within the limits specified by the engine manufacturer. For high-temperature (HT) fresh water circuits, the maximum inlet temperature to the engine shall not exceed 36°C above the thermostat opening temperature under worst-case ambient conditions.

exact_passages.text:
IACS Unified Requirements M3.1 — Temperature Monitoring and Alarm
Cooling water temperature of main propulsion engines shall be continuously monitored. High temperature alarms shall be set not to exceed the engine manufacturer's maximum permissible cooling water temperature. Where automatic slow-down or shutdown is fitted, the activation set-point shall be above the alarm set-point and shall not exceed the manufacturer's absolute maximum cooling water temperature limit.
整理说明：IACS UR M3.1 对主机冷却水温度监控、报警设定及自动降速/停机要求提供了规范级依据。可支撑温度监控、报警阈值及自动保护类需求。

exact_passages.text:
IACS Unified Requirements E10 — Machinery Control Systems
Cooling water temperature control systems for main propulsion engines shall:
1. Maintain cooling water temperature within manufacturer's limits across the full engine load range through automatic modulation of the temperature control valve.
2. Be capable of manual override in case of automatic control failure.
3. Provide alarm when cooling water temperature exceeds the high alarm set-point.
4.

exact_passages.text:
淡水侧系统组成：LT冷却水压力（额定转速下增压空气冷却器进口）≤ 2 bar；PT4145压力传感器测量范围 2 bar 至 8 bar。适用条件：额定转速。

增压空气冷却器（LT级，额定流量）压力损失：6L机型 0.7 bar；7L机型 0.9 bar；8L机型 1.0 bar；9L机型 1.2 bar；10L机型 1.4 bar；12V机型 2.0 bar；14V机型 2.6 bar。适用条件：额定流量。

附设LT冷却水泵（额定转速下）压力升高：6L机型 3.6 bar；7L机型 3.5 bar；8L机型 3.3 bar；9L机型 3.9 bar；10L机型 3.8 bar；12V机型 4.3 bar；14V机型 4.9 bar。适用条件：额定转速。

调节温度：根据功率定义。在较高温度/较低压力下需要降低功率。

可支撑：main_engine_cooling_water_system 的 composition control pressure 参数应依据来源文件厂家技术数据或项目计算文件确定。若原文给出明确限值，可作为对应适用对象和工况下的参数约束。
不能支撑：2. 不能超出来源文件限定的厂家、机型、系统型式或工况范围泛化。3. 不能直接支撑施工安装、冲洗试压或图纸送审完整性要求。

active_kb_record.text:
L16/24S;L16/24：HT冷却水发动机出口温度设定点 79°C 标称（机械恒温元件范围 77-85°C）；LT冷却水发动机出口温度设定点 35°C 标称（机械恒温元件范围 29-41°C）；润滑油进口温度设定点 66°C 标称（机械恒温元件范围 63-72°C）。适用条件：参考工况为热带空气温度，发动机进水温度来自系统，空气压力、相对湿度按温度基准；HT冷却水先流经HT级增压空气冷却器，再流经水套和气缸盖，发动机出口水温由机械恒温器调节；LT冷却水先流经LT级增压空气冷却器，再流经滑油冷却器，发动机出口水温由机械恒温器调节。

可支撑：lt_cooling_water_loop 的 composition control pressure 参数应依据来源文件厂家技术数据或项目计算文件确定。若原文给出明确限值，可作为对应适用对象和工况下的参数约束。
不能支撑：2. 不能超出来源文件限定的厂家、机型、系统型式或工况范围泛化。3. 不能直接支撑施工安装、冲洗试压或图纸送审完整性要求。

raw_row.topic: 主机冷却水进出口参数
raw_row.shall_statement: 主机冷却水系统应保证主机入口和出口的冷却水温度、压力、流量满足主机厂家技术文件规定的限值要求，并在全负荷范围内通过温度控制阀自动调节维持温度在厂家限值内。
raw_row.engineering_rationale: 本条覆盖方面【主机冷却水进出口参数】，来自原始需求「主机入口和出口冷却水温度、压力、流量应满足主机厂家技术文件要求」。E-DNV-COOL-001 支撑了进机温度应保持在厂家限值内的规则义务；E-IACS-M3-002 支撑了温度连续监控和报警设定值不超过厂家最高允许值的要求；E-CTRL-COOL-001 支撑了全负荷范围自动调节和手动备用要求；E-SYS-COMP-004 支撑了LT冷却水压力限值（≤2 bar）的厂家数据；E-TSENS-PRESS-005 支撑了预加热工况下的温度要求。
acceptance_criteria: 设计审查确认冷却水系统设计参数（温度、压力、流量）与主机厂家技术文件一致。
高温报警设定值不超过主机厂家允许的最高冷却水温度，具体限值按主机厂家 Technical Data 确认。
温度控制阀应能在全负荷范围内自动调节，并具备手动备用功能，具体调节精度按监控系统设计规格书要求。
LT冷却水压力（额定转速下增压空气冷却器进口）≤ 2 bar，该数值来自证据 E-SYS-COMP-004 原文，适用于MAN 49/60系列机型。
预加热工况下冷却水温度应满足主机厂家技术文件要求，具体数值按主机厂家 Technical Data 确认。
applicability_constraints: 本条需求基于 DNV 规则、IACS UR M3.1/E10 及 MAN 49/60 系列、L16/24 机型证据，适用范围限于上述规则和厂家机型，其他厂家和机型应按各自 Technical Data 另行确认。
LT冷却水压力限值 ≤ 2 bar 仅适用于 MAN 49/60 系列机型额定转速工况，其他机型不得直接套用。
raw_row.risk_if_unmet: 冷却水参数超出厂家限值将导致主机过热、部件损坏或自动降速/停机，影响航行安全。

raw_row.topic: 高低温回路设计参数一致性
raw_row.shall_statement: 高温冷却水回路和低温冷却水回路的设计参数应与主机技术数据、泵曲线、冷却器选型和热平衡计算保持一致，确保各回路在设计工况下满足主机冷却需求。
raw_row.engineering_rationale: 本条覆盖方面【高低温回路设计参数一致性】，来自原始需求「高温冷却水回路和低温冷却水回路的设计参数应与主机技术数据、泵曲线、冷却器选型和热平衡计算保持一致」。E-DNV-COOL-001 支撑了HT回路进机温度不超过调温阀开启温度+36°C的规则要求；E-LT-COMP-005 和 E-LT-COMP-006 支撑了HT和LT冷却水出口温度设定点及恒温元件范围；E-HT-COMP-082 支撑了HT冷却水流经路径和调节温度；E-COOLER-PRESS-060 支撑了LT级中冷器进口冷却水温度限值。

active_kb_record.text:
冷却液水质检测方法：当使用化学添加剂时，测试设备应依据供应商建议；供应商提供的测试套件可用于测定淡水水质。

适用对象/类别（冷却液，无添加剂）：总硬度 ≤ 10 dGH；pH值 6.5 – 8 在20 °C；氯离子含量 ≤ 50 mg/l。适用条件：用于填充和补充的水（无添加剂）。

适用对象/类别（冷却液，有添加剂）：总硬度 ≤ 10 dGH；pH值 ≥ 7.5 在20 °C；氯离子含量 ≤ 50 mg/l。适用条件：循环水（有添加剂）。

可支撑：coolant 的 inspection；water_quality；environmental_protection 参数应依据来源文件厂家技术数据或项目计算文件确定。若原文给出明确限值，可作为对应适用对象和工况下的参数约束。

不能支撑：2. 不能超出来源文件限定的厂家、机型、系统型式或工况范围泛化。3. 不能直接支撑施工安装、冲洗试压或图纸送审完整性要求。

冷却液冰点与乙二醇比例：服务时间 = 12000小时或6年；Cat ELC不需要频繁添加SCA（补充冷却液添加剂）；在6000服务小时或ELC使用寿命的一半时，仅需添加Extender；Cat ELC以1:1预混合冷却液形式提供，使用蒸馏水；预混合ELC提供防冻保护至-37°C（-34°F）；预混合ELC推荐用于冷却系统的初始加注；预混合ELC也推荐用于冷却系统的加满；ELC浓缩液也可使用；ELC浓缩液可将冰点降低至-52°C（-62°F），适用于北极条件。适用条件：Cat ELC冷却液，基于Caterpillar EC-1规范。

冷却液水质检测方法：未处理冷却液的性质必须符合以下限值：总硬度 ≤ 10 dGH；pH值 6.5 – 8；氯离子含量 ≤ 50 mg/l。适用条件：水质类型为蒸馏水或淡水，无外来杂质。1 dGH（德国硬度）≙ 10 mg CaO/升水 ≙ 17.9 mg CaCO3/l ≙ 0.357 mval/l ≙ 0.179 mmol/l；1 mg/l ≙ 1 ppm。MAN Energy Solutions 水质检测设备包含直接测定上述水性质的装置。防腐蚀剂制造商也提供用户友好的检测设备。冷却水检查说明见 010.005 Engine – Work Instructions 010.000.002-03。若使用蒸馏水（例如来自淡水发生器）或完全脱盐水，需注意相关要求。

active_kb_record.text:
冷却液污染与沉积风险
Corrosion is a chemical or electrochemical action that gradually wears away metal surfaces in the cooling system. In some instances, corrosion can eventually destroy an engine. All cooling system components need protection from corrosion. Supplemental coolant additives are used to protect metal surfaces. They coat these surfaces and prevent the formation of scale, rust, and cavitation erosion. Types of cooling system corrosion are pitting and cavitation erosion, rust, acidity-alkalinity imbalance caused erosion, and galvanic and electrolytic corrosion. Other functional effects of coolants with no, or low, levels of supplemental coolant additives are aeration and the formation of scale and deposits. Pitting and Cavitation-Erosion Electrical current flow in a localized area is one of the causes of pitting corrosion. Pitting is the most damaging type of corrosion.

active_kb_record.text:
水质参数要求
In closed circuits only Additives may only be used in closed circuits where no significant consump- tion occurs, apart from leaks or evaporation losses. Observe the applicable environmental protection regulations when disposing of coolant containing additives. For more information, consult the additive supplier. Chemical additives Sodium nitrite and sodium borate based additives etc. have a proven track re- cord. Galvanised iron pipes or zinc sacrificial anodes must not be used in cooling systems. This corrosion protection is not required due to the pre- scribed coolant treatment and electrochemical potential reversal that may oc- cur due to the coolant temperatures which are usual in engines nowadays. If necessary, the pipes must be deplated. Slushing oil For MAN Energy Solutions engines, it is not permissible to use corrosion pro- tection oils in the cooling water circuit.

重要：出于腐蚀防护原因，不得储存于镀锌容器中；当冷却液需要转移时需考虑此要求；容器应密封储存于阴凉干燥处；寒冷季节需确保适当的防冻保护。适用条件：通用冷却液储存与处理。

可支撑：coolant 的 water_quality；corrosion_protection；temperature 参数应依据来源文件、厂家技术数据或项目计算文件确定。若原文给出明确限值，可作为对应适用对象和工况下的参数约束。

不能支撑：2. 不能超出来源文件限定的厂家、机型、系统型式或工况范围泛化。3. 不能直接支撑施工安装、冲洗试压或图纸送审完整性要求。

active_kb_record.text:
冷却液水质检测方法：当使用化学添加剂时，测试设备应依据供应商建议；供应商提供的测试套件可用于测定淡水水质。

适用对象/类别（冷却液，无添加剂）：总硬度 ≤ 10 dGH；pH值 6.5 – 8 在20 °C；氯离子含量 ≤ 50 mg/l。适用条件：用于填充和补充的水（无添加剂）。

适用对象/类别（冷却液，有添加剂）：总硬度 ≤ 10 dGH；pH值 ≥ 7.5 在20 °C；氯离子含量 ≤ 50 mg/l。适用条件：循环水（有添加剂）。

可支撑：coolant 的 inspection；water_quality；environmental_protection 参数应依据来源文件厂家技术数据或项目计算文件确定。若原文给出明确限值，可作为对应适用对象和工况下的参数约束。

不能支撑：2. 不能超出来源文件限定的厂家、机型、系统型式或工况范围泛化。3. 不能直接支撑施工安装、冲洗试压或图纸送审完整性要求。

active_kb_record.text:
冷却液冰点与乙二醇比例：服务时间 = 12000小时或6年；Cat ELC不需要频繁添加SCA（补充冷却液添加剂）；在6000服务小时或ELC使用寿命的一半时，仅需添加Extender；Cat ELC以1:1预混合冷却液形式提供，使用蒸馏水；预混合ELC提供防冻保护至-37°C（-34°F）；预混合ELC推荐用于冷却系统的初始加注；预混合ELC也推荐用于冷却系统的加满；ELC浓缩液也可使用；ELC浓缩液可将冰点降低至-52°C（-62°F），适用于北极条件。适用条件：Cat ELC冷却液，基于Caterpillar EC-1规范。

可支撑：coolant 的 water_quality；maintenance；temperature 参数应依据来源文件厂家技术数据或项目计算文件确定。若原文给出明确限值，可作为对应适用对象和工况下的参数约束。
不能支撑：2. 不能超出来源文件限定的厂家、机型、系统型式或工况范围泛化。3. 不能直接支撑施工安装、冲洗试压或图纸送审完整性要求。

active_kb_record.text:
冷却液水质检测方法：未处理冷却液的性质必须符合以下限值：总硬度 ≤ 10 dGH；pH值 6.5 – 8；氯离子含量 ≤ 50 mg/l。适用条件：水质类型为蒸馏水或淡水，无外来杂质。1 dGH（德国硬度）≙ 10 mg CaO/升水 ≙ 17.9 mg CaCO3/l ≙ 0.357 mval/l ≙ 0.179 mmol/l；1 mg/l ≙ 1 ppm。MAN Energy Solutions 水质检测设备包含直接测定上述水性质的装置。防腐蚀剂制造商也提供用户友好的检测设备。冷却水检查说明见 010.005 Engine – Work Instructions 010.000.002-03。若使用蒸馏水（例如来自淡水发生器）或完全脱盐水，需注意相关要求。

可支撑：coolant 的 inspection；water_quality 参数应依据来源文件、厂家技术数据或项目计算文件确定。若原文给出明确限值，可作为对应适用对象和工况下的参数约束。
不能支撑：2. 不能超出来源文件限定的厂家、机型、系统型式或工况范围泛化。3. 不能直接支撑施工安装、冲洗试压或图纸送审完整性要求。

ascertained and evaluated on an ongoing basis. Any time a substantial amount of cooling water is changed or added, the inhibitor concentration should be checked to ensure a proper level. Improved O-ring compound (peroxide cured) In cases of repeated cooling water leakages from the cool - ing jackets on the cylinder liner or the cylinder cover, we recommend installation of our new O-rings of an improved compound. The new O-rings will provide improved resis - tance against high temperatures and steam in areas where deposits and foreign particles are restricting water flow. The peroxide cured O-rings are not standard on all engine types, but will be delivered on request from our PrimeServ organisation. In our previous SL2001-393, we recommended the use of oversize O-rings (i.e. O-rings with a slightly larger cross section).

active_kb_record.text:
冷却液污染与沉积风险
Corrosion is a chemical or electrochemical action that gradually wears away metal surfaces in the cooling system. In some instances, corrosion can eventually destroy an engine. All cooling system components need protection from corrosion. Supplemental coolant additives are used to protect metal surfaces. They coat these surfaces and prevent the formation of scale, rust, and cavitation erosion. Types of cooling system corrosion are pitting and cavitation erosion, rust, acidity-alkalinity imbalance caused erosion, and galvanic and electrolytic corrosion. Other functional effects of coolants with no, or low, levels of supplemental coolant additives are aeration and the formation of scale and deposits. Pitting and Cavitation-Erosion Electrical current flow in a localized area is one of the causes of pitting corrosion. Pitting is the most damaging type of corrosion.

水质参数要求
In closed circuits only Additives may only be used in closed circuits where no significant consump- tion occurs, apart from leaks or evaporation losses. Observe the applicable environmental protection regulations when disposing of coolant containing additives. For more information, consult the additive supplier. Chemical additives Sodium nitrite and sodium borate based additives etc. have a proven track re- cord. Galvanised iron pipes or zinc sacrificial anodes must not be used in cooling systems. This corrosion protection is not required due to the pre- scribed coolant treatment and electrochemical potential reversal that may oc- cur due to the coolant temperatures which are usual in engines nowadays. If necessary, the pipes must be deplated. Slushing oil For MAN Energy Solutions engines, it is not permissible to use corrosion pro- tection oils in the cooling water circuit.

Separate Circuit Aftercooled with Heat Exchangers with Aftercooler Seawater Recirculation The separate circuit aftercooler cooling system must be designed with sufficient capacity for the hottest water and the higher ambient air conditions for operation in climates where both air and seawater temperatures run to extremes. This results in a cooler with excess capacity in cold seawater and warm air conditions. This can result in condensation in the engine’s intake system, especially during prolonged light engine load. Extremely cold seawater in the aftercooler can also cause condensation when engine inlet air temperatures are relatively warm with high moisture content. The thermostatic valve used should not allow the temperature of the water to the aftercooler to exceed 30°C (85°F).

冷却水温度与压力参数
Preheating Engines starting on HFO and engines in stand-by position must be preheated. It is also recommended to preheat engines operating on MDO due to the pro- longed life time of the engines' wearing parts. Therefore it is recommended that the preheating is arranged for automatic operation, so that the preheating is disconnected when the engine is running, and connected when the engine is in stand-by position. The preheating is adjusted so that the temperature is ≥ 60°C at the top cover (see thermometer TI12), and approximately 25 to 45°C at out- let of the cylinders (see thermometer TI10). When working out the external cooling water system it must be ensured, that no cold cooling water is pressed through the engine and thus spoiling the pre- heating during stand-by.

Separate Circuit Aftercooled with Heat Exchangers with Aftercooler Seawater Recirculation The separate circuit aftercooler cooling system must be designed with sufficient capacity for the hottest water and the higher ambient air conditions for operation in climates where both air and seawater temperatures run to extremes. This results in a cooler with excess capacity in cold seawater and warm air conditions. This can result in condensation in the engine’s intake system, especially during prolonged light engine load. Extremely cold seawater in the aftercooler can also cause condensation when engine inlet air temperatures are relatively warm with high moisture content. The thermostatic valve used should not allow the temperature of the water to the aftercooler to exceed 30°C (85°F).

冷却水温度与压力参数
Preheating Engines starting on HFO and engines in stand-by position must be preheated. It is also recommended to preheat engines operating on MDO due to the pro- longed life time of the engines' wearing parts. Therefore it is recommended that the preheating is arranged for automatic operation, so that the preheating is disconnected when the engine is running, and connected when the engine is in stand-by position. The preheating is adjusted so that the temperature is ≥ 60°C at the top cover (see thermometer TI12), and approximately 25 to 45°C at out- let of the cylinders (see thermometer TI10). When working out the external cooling water system it must be ensured, that no cold cooling water is pressed through the engine and thus spoiling the pre- heating during stand-by.

温度控制阀：外部管路最大水流速，淡水：3.0 m/s；海水：3.0 m/s。适用条件：外部管路连接。
发动机：HT系统压降约为0.5 bar。适用条件：不包括泵和恒温阀。
润滑油冷却器：冷却水压降约为0.3 bar。适用条件：内置式润滑油冷却器；实际压降可能因冷却器设计不同而异。
恒温阀：压降约为0.5 bar。适用条件：内置式恒温阀。
增压空气冷却器：冷却水压降 ∆P = V² × K [Bar]；V为冷却水流量，单位m³/h；K为常数，参见B 15 00 0，增压空气冷却器。适用条件：冷却水流经增压空气冷却器。
冷却水泵：应为离心式。适用条件：冷却水系统。

不能支撑：2. 不能超出来源文件限定的厂家、机型、系统型式或工况范围泛化。3. 不能直接支撑施工安装、冲洗试压或图纸送审完整性要求。
